claimBoundary: This cycle tests whether the public SH0ES compact release can support the anchor-, host-, and photometric-system interventions frozen in RC62. It may reproduce and stress-test the released 2022 linear ladder, but it cannot stand in for unreleased 2024-2025 HST, JWST, or SMC measurements.

numericalBaseline.referenceFileRole: The official README says lstsq_results constructs a broad initial prior; it is not a precision posterior reference vector.

semanticInterventionGate.claimRefused: Named leave-one-anchor, host, photometric-system, and HST-versus-JWST causal estimates

anonymousSingleRowInfluence.method: exact correlated Gaussian marginal deletion using the precision-matrix rank-one identity

anonymousDesignSignatureBlocks.method: exact covariance-preserving deletion grouped only by identical nonzero design columns

adjudication.reason: The released numerical system reproduces H0, but it omits row identities, parameter identities, covariance ancestry, and the later SMC/JWST branches required for named interventions.
